capabilities: Render LaTeX and TikZ diagrams from tikz code blocks in notes
Load LaTeX packages with \usepackage{} before rendering
Draw graphs, figures, circuits, chemical diagrams, and commutative diagrams
Use the standalone document class for rendering
extras: The README notes that the standalone document class is used and lists the exact set of supported LaTeX packages, which limits what diagrams can be rendered.
intentEvidence: This plugin would not be possible without TikZJax by @kisonecat!
problem: Obsidian's built-in math rendering covers equations but cannot render standalone TikZ diagrams or figures inside notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin would not be possible without TikZJax by @kisonecat!
it uses @drgrice1's fork that adds some additional features

summary: TikZ renderer that turns tikz code blocks in notes into LaTeX and TikZ diagrams such as graphs, circuits, and chemical figures.
